Undertaking businesses with good conscience towards the society, the community and the environment is an important driving force to sustainable development of the community and the nation at large.

BTS Group places emphasis on sustainable development of its business together with the development of the society and the community in order to provide better quality of life, build a strong foundation and deliver happiness to the society and the community. BTS Group conducts its business by continuously developing and improving its operations to be environmental friendly or causing minimal impact on the environment, as well as fostering a culture of individual social and environmental responsibility within the organization.

The Company’s personnel are encouraged to participate in the Group’s social responsibility activities, which are arranged regularly across the nation. They shall protect and effectively manage the use of finite resources, including energy, water, etc. as well as contributing to minimizing harmful emissions and waste to the environment, such as carbon dioxide (CO2) and other air emissions or discharges to water. In addition, the Company’s personnel shall implement sustainable sourcing and select business partners who share the Company’s concern on the social and environmental responsibility.

To declare an intention on sustainable development of its business together with the development of the society, community, and environment, the Group has prepared the sustainability report in accordance with Sustainability Reporting Guidelines of the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) in order to communicate the policy and the performance result of corporate social responsibilities through economy, environment, and social indicators.
